Name: Confeitaria do Bolhão
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). 08:45 breakfast option - galão + nata. Opens 07:00 on Saturdays. 2 min from hotel.

Name: Molete Bread & Breakfast
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). 08:45 breakfast option - local chain, fresh bread, bôla saloia (savoury Portuguese cake). 8 min walk.

Name: SO Coffee Roasters
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). 08:45 breakfast option - best specialty coffee in the city. Single-origin V60/Chemex, sourdough toast. 10 min walk.

Name: Matosinhos Beach
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). 09:30 - walk to Trindade Metro (8 min), Line A Red to Matosinhos-Sul, ~20-25 min, Z3 1.85 EUR/person. Door-to-sand ~35 min. Go before 10:30 for space. Wide Atlantic sand, lifeguarded, clean showers.

Name: Beach shacks on the promenade
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). 11:30 lunch - the r/porto pick. Plastic chairs, grilled fish of the day, Super Bock. No booking, just sit down. 5-10 min from the beach.

Name: Salta o Muro
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). 11:30 lunch option - no-frills staple, octopus rice, deep-fried sardines. Walk-in.

Name: O Gaveto
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). 11:30 lunch splurge - the definitive Porto seafood experience since 1984, Krug Ambassade 2025. Order from the fish display. Book by Fri Aug 14 for Sat Aug 22.

Name: Mercado - Food & Drinks
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). 11:30 lunch option - pick your fish at the market stalls, they prep it, the restaurant cooks it. Walk-in.

Name: Foz do Douro
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). 13:30 - Uber from Matosinhos ~8 EUR/10 min, or walk the seafront promenade through Parque da Cidade (~40 min, lovely). Where the Douro meets the Atlantic - gardens, the 1843 lighthouse, riverside cafés.

Name: Pão - Padaria Artesanal
Address: Mercado da Foz, Rua de Diu 365, Porto
Tips: Afternoon coffee inside Mercado da Foz - organic sourdough, canned fish toast.

Name: Tram 1 (Passeio Alegre)
Tips: OPTION A 15:30 / OPTION B 15:00 - the ride back down the river. Oldest tram line in Europe (1872), open wooden carriages along the Douro. ~25 min to Massarelos, every 20-30 min. Buy on board, cash.

Name: Museu do Carro Eléctrico
Tips: OPTION A 16:00 / OPTION B 15:30 - get off at Massarelos, the museum is at the tram stop. 25 historic trams inside a 1915 power plant - 24 EUR for our four (both girls fit the 6-25 band). Sat 10:00-18:00, last entry 17:30, allow 45 min. Ticket includes one free tram/metro/bus ride within 4 hrs - save it for the hop home.

Name: Jardim do Palácio de Cristal
Address: Rua Dom Manuel II, Massarelos, Porto
Tips: OPTION A 17:00 / OPTION B 16:35 - 10 min uphill from the Tram Museum or one more stop on Tram 1. Daily 08:00-21:00 in summer. Free-roaming peacocks, the best free thing in Porto with kids. Walk to the western belvederes for the Douro views most tourists miss.

Name: Museu Romântico da Quinta da Macieirinha
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). 18:00 optional, 30 min. Adjacent to the Crystal Palace gardens. King Carlos Alberto of Sardinia died here in exile in 1849. Recreated mid-19th-century bourgeois rooms, almost no tourists.

Name: Cedofeita
Tips: OPTION A 18:30 / OPTION B 18:10 - walk back to the hotel through Porto's bohemian arts district.

Name: Cortiço & Netos
Address: Top of Rua das Flores, Porto
Tips: Souvenir stop on the walk home - authentic antique and reproduction azulejo tiles, the real thing, not tourist ceramics.

Name: Serralves Museum + Park
Address: Rua Dom João de Castro 210, 4150-417 Porto
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). ALTERNATIVE AFTERNOON if you skip the hidden-gems loop. Álvaro Siza modernist building plus an 18-hectare park with farm animals, treetop walkway, rose garden. Uber from Foz ~6 EUR, 10 min.

Name: Rua Miguel Bombarda Arts District
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). ALTERNATIVE AFTERNOON - Porto's bohemian gallery quarter, 20+ galleries, the 130 sq m Don Quixote mural, independent shops. Uber to Cedofeita ~7 EUR.

Name: Casa da Música
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). ALTERNATIVE AFTERNOON - Rem Koolhaas concert hall, striking exterior, guided tour at 16:00. Uber from Foz ~8 EUR, 12 min.

Name: The Yeatman Bar
Address: Rua do Choupelo 88, 4400-088 Vila Nova de Gaia
Tips: 18:30 pre-dinner drinks - terrace overlooking all of Porto, wine flights. Cross Dom Luís I Bridge then 5 min uphill.

Name: Bar Clássico
Address: Near Rua de Santo Ildefonso, Porto
Tips: 18:30 pre-dinner drinks option - old-school Portuguese bar, cheap and authentic, near the hotel.

Name: Gruta
Tips: 20:00 farewell dinner, top pick. Michelin Bib Gourmand, Atlantic seafood tasting menu. BOOK TODAY - tiny room, limited seating.

Name: Escama
Tips: 20:00 FAREWELL DINNER PICK. The turbot with hazelnut vinaigrette is legendary. NOTE THE ADDRESS - Escama has MOVED to Cais da Ribeira 29; older listings still show Rua de Mouzinho da Silveira 203, which is the old room. Open daily 12:30-15:00 and 19:00-22:30. BOOK NOW via TheFork on escamaporto.com, reservas@escamaporto.com or +351 913 595 551. Puts you on the quay for the last Ribeira night walk.

Name: Cais da Ribeira
Tips: 22:00 last night - walk back through the illuminated waterfront one final time. Pack tonight, Sunday starts at 05:45.

Name: Restaurante Tito
Address: Rua Herois de Franca 279 and 321 Matosinhos
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). 11:30 lunch option - family workhorse of the grill street sardines robalo dourada turbot Mains come with garlic parsley potatoes and cabbage No reservations

Name: Casa Serrao
Tips: OPTION A (beach day - dropped Aug 22, too cold). 11:30 lunch option - cod fried or grilled generous portions cheaper than neighbours Local regulars pick

Name: Casa Expresso
Tips: 20:00 farewell dinner LOCALS PICK Chalkboard menu rewritten daily dishes 5-6 EUR Sandes de rojao alheira No reservations arrive early Cash

Name: O Rapido
Tips: 20:00 farewell dinner alternative Classic tasca by Sao Bento Saturday is tripas a moda do Porto day Walk-in

Name: Bus 500 to Foz
Address: Praça da Liberdade / São Bento, Porto
Cost Range: 1.40 EUR Z2 Andante (~2.50-3 EUR cash on board)
Tips: OPTION B 12:00 - bus 500 runs the riverside road from Praça da Liberdade / São Bento out to Passeio Alegre in Foz, ~25-30 min, every ~20 min. The cheap scenic way out; it carries on to Matosinhos Mercado.

Name: Casa de Pasto da Palmeira
Address: Rua do Passeio Alegre, Foz do Douro, Porto
Tips: OPTION B 12:35 lunch pick - old Foz dining room 2 min from the Tram 1 terminus. Lighter, more inventive Portuguese cooking than the grill street, warm room, no seafront mark-up. Tue-Sat 12:00-24:00, Sun to 19:00, closed Mon. Phone +351 226 168 244. NOTE listings split between no. 294 and no. 450 - it is the one on the garden side.

Name: Tavi - Confeitaria da Foz
Address: Rua da Senhora da Luz 363, 4150-698 Porto
Tips: OPTION B lunch or the 15:00 coffee stop - confeitaria since 1935 with a glassed terrace straight out over the Atlantic. The best chilly-day room in Foz. Daily 07:30-20:00. Walk round the back and down the viaduct for Praia da Luz.

Name: Mercado da Foz
Address: Rua de Diu 365, Foz do Douro, Porto
Tips: OPTION B - the warm indoor bail-out if the wind wins. Stalls plus Pão - Padaria Artesanal for sourdough and canned-fish toasts. Walk-in.

Name: Jardim do Passeio Alegre
Address: Passeio Alegre, Foz do Douro, Porto
Tips: OPTION B 14:00 - 19th-century promenade garden at the river mouth: palms, obelisks, bandstand, chess tables. The Tram 1 terminus is here, so it is both the arrival and the departure point of the afternoon.

Name: Capela de São Miguel-o-Anjo
Address: Rua do Passeio Alegre, Foz do Douro, Porto
Tips: OPTION B 14:00 - 1527 chapel AND lighthouse in one building, the oldest lighthouse in Portugal, raised by Bishop Dom Miguel da Silva to guide ships over the Douro bar. A National Monument the size of a garage, and almost nobody stops.

Name: Igreja de São João Baptista da Foz
Address: Largo da Igreja, Foz do Douro, Porto
Tips: OPTION B ~14:20 - Foz parish church, mid-1600s. Plain outside; inside, one of the best Johannine gilded altarpieces in Porto plus eight side altars of talha dourada. No ticket, no queue, 2 min from the garden.

Name: Farol das Felgueiras
Address: Molhe de Felgueiras, Foz do Douro, Porto
Tips: OPTION B 14:00 - 300 m breakwater out to the hexagonal red lighthouse, Douro on one side and open Atlantic on the other. WARNING wet granite, no railing, swell breaks over it. Turn back at the first wave that reaches your feet; do not go out if water is washing across the blocks.

Name: Pérgola da Foz
Address: Avenida do Brasil, Foz do Douro, Porto
Tips: OPTION B - the 1930s seafront colonnade a Porto mayor's wife copied from Nice. Walk it north as far as the legs want and turn back at any point.

Name: Igreja do Carmo - paid circuit
Cost Range: ~7 EUR/person (Casa Escondida alone ~2 EUR) - confirm at the door
Tips: OPTION B 17:20, the one paid stop of the walk home. The circuit covers the catacombs, the decorated halls and sacristy, and the interior of the 1-metre-wide Casa Escondida. Summer Apr-Oct daily 09:30-18:00. WARNING working parish - Mass closes the circuit without notice, most likely Saturday evening. If the desk is shut, take Café Majestic instead.

Name: Igreja de São Martinho de Cedofeita
Tips: OPTION B 18:10 - the oldest church in Porto, a Romanesque rebuild of the 1100s on a 6th-century Suevi foundation. Cito Facta (made quickly) gave the quarter its name. WARNING interior opens Tue-Fri 16:00-19:00 only, so Saturday is an exterior visit.

Name: Café Majestic
Tips: OPTION B 18:40 - the paid sit-down with no closing-time risk, 3 min from the hotel. The 1921 Belle Epoque room: gilded mirrors, carved mahogany, white-jacketed waiters. Mon-Sat 09:00-23:00. Pay the tourist premium once and sit for 45 minutes.
